summary: Wave 1A JWT alignment successfully delivers all requirements with no blocking issues. Config alignment (FEAT-001) replaces JWT_SECRET_KEY with JWT_SECRET and ADMIN_JWT_SECRET matching SHC environment variables. JWT validation (FEAT-002) enforces issuer='skillhubcore.in' and implements strict secret-to-tokenType binding preventing privilege escalation. Test coverage (FEAT-003) includes 35 tests with 97% auth module coverage. All prior blocking issues resolved: userId claim extraction works with real SHC tokens, admin privilege flags exposed to application code, strict secret binding prevents token forgery, privilege enforcement tested end-to-end, and TypeScript generateAccessToken now sets issuer. Integration is complete and deployment-ready.
